apoiar iniciativas de automação e governança de processos. • Colaboração Multidisciplinar: atuar em conjunto com TI, Segurança, Rede e áreas de negócio, propondo soluções que facilitem o cumprimento dos requisitos de compliance sem perder eficiência operacional. • Garantir atuação no modelo Agile gerenciando solução de suporte e demandas necessárias para diretoria de Risk & Compliance. • Garantir evolução e melhorias para solução de GRC implementada.Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação: • Experiência em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC)• Experiência em controles internos e frameworks de TI e Segurança (CoSO, COBIT, ITIL, NIST, ITGC, SoD, IT Risk Assessment).• Project Management no modelo Agile e tradicional Waterfall, e ferramentas de marcado como Azure Devops. • Experiência na plataforma Microsoft e gerenciar banco de dados como Power BI, PowrApps, Power Automate fundamental, Dataverse • Experiência em soluções de IA como Copilot premium e Studio, e soluções de Multi-agentes. • Conhecimento em controles e requisitos de segurança da informação/Compliance. • Graduação em Sistemas da Informação, TI ou áreas correlatas. • Certificação em Riscos e Controles: CCSA (Certification in Control Self-Assessment), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control);• Certificação em Agile/Scrum (PSM, CSM) ou PMP com ênfase em metodologias ágeis; • Certificações Data Analytics, ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau); • Certificação em produtos Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals.

title: Master Data Modeler
description: Position Summary and LocationSupport the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.Duties and Responsibilities Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data. Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies. Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices. Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data. Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures. Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems. Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems. Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications. Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes. Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage. Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members. Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus. Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures. Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools. Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures. Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.Desired Qualifications Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design. Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL. Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.


Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered .

Main Responsibilities

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.

title: Secretária
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados — e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor — e possível — continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About You

You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined.

You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms.
  • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.
  • Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage.
  • Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
  • Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners.
  • Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests.
  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
  • Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
  • Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.


Qualifications

  • Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Analista De Inteligência De Negócios Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Acompanhar de forma próxima a performance dos shoppings, com leitura aprofundada dos principais drivers de resultado;
  • Realizar análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com foco nos indicadores operacionais Identificar, estruturar e priorizar alavancas de resultado, avaliando impacto, viabilidade e retorno financeiro;
  • Desenvolver análises estratégicas integradas, conectando desempenho financeiro, comercial e operacional dos ativos;
  • Atuar em parceria com as Regionais e Shoppings, traduzindo análises em direcionamentos táticos claros e acionáveis;
  • Preparar materiais executivos e apoiar fóruns e apresentações para a Diretoria;
  • Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Analista em áreas estratégicas;
  • Vivência em análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com leitura crítica de indicadores de resultado;
  • Domínio de indicadores como: margem, custos, vendas, SSS, rentabilidade e performance operacional;
  • Experiência na construção de recomendações estratégicas e suporte à tomada de decisão executiva;
  • Habilidade paratraduzir dados complexos em insights claros;
  • Excel avançado e experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (ex.: Power BI, similares).


Informações adicionais:

O Que Temos Para Você

title: Azure Devops Engineer
description:
About you

You are a senior-level DevOps Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You’re comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.

  • Strong proficiency with Azure services, including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure OpenAI.

  • Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
  • Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps , and related toolchains.
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights.
  • Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security.
  • Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases.
  • Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
  • Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote DevOps culture, automation, and continuous improvement.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Estamos com 1 vaga de Especialista em Provisões Técnicas, com foco em IFRS17 . Confira os detalhes abaixo:


FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA


  • Necessário superior completo em Ciências Atuariais;
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Ciências Atuariais, Estatística, Finanças, Economia, Seguros, Resseguros ou Engenharia.


EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS


  • Imprescindível possuir experiência no mercado de seguros ou resseguros ou auditoria ou consultoria;

  • Necessário conhecimento da norma IFRS 17;
  • Desejável conhecimento SAS;
  • Conhecimento delinguagens de programação (diferencial).



MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO


  • Responsável por supervisionar, desenvolver, orientar tecnicamente, garantir e realizar as projeções de fluxos de caixa sob a norma contábil IFRS 17, assegurando a precisão e consistência dos cálculos, baseando-se nas metodologias descritas nas Notas Técnicas Atuariais, visando alinhamento com a legislação vigente (IFRS 17) e atendimento ao cronograma da companhia.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Realizar as projeções de fluxos de caixa sob a norma IFRS 17, com foco na avaliação de contratos de resseguro e suas respectivas provisões;
  • Conduzir os testes de consistência e validação de dados atuariais usando Excel (tabelas dinâmicas e fórmulas complexas);
  • Manipular e analisar os dados em grande escala utilizando a ferramenta SAS, gerando relatórios e insights para otimizar a avaliação das projeções e decisões estratégicas;
  • Interagir com diferentes áreas (financeira, contábil, risco) para assegurar a integridade das informações e o cumprimento dos prazos regulamentares;
  • Desenvolver apresentações e relatórios que detalham as análises atuarial-financeiras realizadas para comitês internos e reguladores externos;
  • Identificar oportunidades e execução de melhorias em metodologias atuariais e modelos estatísticos desenvolvidos em SAS;
  • Manter-se atualizado quanto à adequação aos normativos técnicos oficiais e às orientações da companhia;
  • Multiplicar o conhecimento técnico adquirido, por meio de experiência e treinamentos, para clientes, parceiros e equipe de Atuários.

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica

  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida

title: Analista De Validação De Processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.

2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).

3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.

4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.

5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

title: Sales & Trading Intern
description:
Sobre o Grupo BCP Securities

Fundada em 1989, a BCP Securities, Inc. é uma corretora e banco de investimento americano com foco em renda fixa em mercados emergentes. Com sede em Greenwich, Connecticut, e escritórios em cidades estratégicas como Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Cidade do México e Singapura, a BCP é referência global em soluções financeiras personalizadas. Reconhecida por sua excelência e compromisso ético, a empresa oferece serviços inovadores e eficazes para atender às necessidades de clientes ao redor do mundo.

Sobre a BCP DTVM

A BCP DTVM é uma instituição financeira voltada para originação, estruturação e distribuição de ativos financeiros, com destaque para crédito privado e operações estruturadas. Nossa atuação inclui uma mesa ativa de negociações no mercado secundário, promovendo liquidez e transparência para os clientes.

Expandindo do mercado offshore para o mercado local, a BCP DTVM combina expertise técnica e agilidade, atendendo empresas, investidores institucionais e family offices com soluções sólidas e inovadoras. Somos o lugar certo para profissionais que buscam um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados, contribuindo para o futuro do mercado financeiro brasileiro.


Local de Trabalho : cidade do Rio de Janeiro, 100% presencial

Tipo de Contrato : estágio


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a mesa de Sales & Trading no acompanhamento diário do mercado local de renda fixa, com foco em crédito privado (debêntures, CRIs, CRAs, notas comerciais e outros instrumentos).
  • Auxiliar na atualização e controle das posições da mesa, acompanhando marcação a mercado, preços, spreads e movimentações diárias.
  • Apoiar a equipe de Sales no atendimento a demandas de clientes institucionais, family offices e investidores profissionais, incluindo envio de cotações, informações de mercado e materiais de suporte.
  • Monitorar e organizar o pipeline de oportunidades no mercado secundário, contribuindo com a execução e acompanhamento de negociações.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e “market updates” (diários e semanais), incluindo destaques do mercado, principais movimentos e níveis indicativos.
  • Utilizar sistemas internos e plataformas de mercado (ex.: Bloomberg, ANBIMA, B3, CETIP/NoMe/RTC, conforme aplicável) para consultas de preços, volumes e informações dos ativos.
  • Auxiliar na checagem de operações e interface com áreas de Middle/Backoffice, garantindo alinhamento entre negociação, registro e liquidação.
  • Organizar bases de dados, planilhas e controles internos, garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria de processos e automação de rotinas (Excel/VBA/Python, quando aplicável).
  • Colaborar com o time na preparação de apresentações, materiais comerciais e documentos de apoio para reuniões com clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Cursando graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Interesse genuíno por mercado financeiro, especialmente renda fixa, crédito privado e macroeconomia local.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, organização de bases).
  • Boa capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e perfil organizado.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional para interação com áreas internas e clientes.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, com agilidade e priorização em rotina de mesa.
  • Disponibilidade para estágio presencial na cidade do Rio de Janeiro (Ipanema).


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento básico de produtos de renda fixa (duration, curva, spread, marcação a mercado).
  • Familiaridade com Bloomberg e/ou plataformas de negociação.
  • Noções de VBA, Python, Power BI ou automação de relatórios.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.


Benefícios:

  • Bolsa Estágio
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa global com forte atuação no mercado de renda fixa.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e dinâmico.

title: Engenheiro De Software Cloud Aws
description:
Cód. 57953


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

;

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior Fullstack com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações web robustas, escaláveis e seguras , atuando de ponta a ponta (front-end e back-end), com forte integração a tecnologias SAP (ex.: SRM, S/4HANA) e ambientes em nuvem.


Esse(a) profissional será responsável por propor soluções técnicas, apoiar decisões de arquitetura, aplicar boas práticas de DevSecOps , colaborar ativamente com times multidisciplinares (design, produto e tecnologia) e contribuir para a evolução contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento , garantindo qualidade, performance e governança das soluções entregues.


Principais Projetos e Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações web de alta performance e escalabilidade, incluindo integrações com soluções SAP
  • Implementar e manter arquiteturas baseadas em microsserviços , com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful robustas
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, governança e codificação segura , alinhadas ao OWASP Top 10
  • Atuar na modelagem e implementação de regras de negócio , participando ativamente do levantamento e entendimento de requisitos
  • Colaborar com designers e demais desenvolvedores na construção de interfaces intuitivas, funcionais e eficientes
  • Realizar revisões de código , promovendo qualidade técnica e disseminação de boas práticas
  • Implementar soluções de caching e otimização para melhorar desempenho e escalabilidade de aplicações e catálogos extensos
  • Apoiar na identificação, análise e correção de bugs e incidentes
  • Atuar com infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS) , utilizando serviços como Lambda , S3, API Gateway e SQS
  • Utilizar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD , aplicando conceitos e ferramentas de DevOps e DevSecOps
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, padrões arquiteturais e práticas de desenvolvimento

Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas


Certificações e Cursos Complementares (Desejáveis)


  • Desenvolvimento Web Avançado
  • Arquitetura de Microsserviços
  • DevSecOps e CI/CD
  • UX/UI Design
  • Segurança da Informação


Certificações desejáveis:


  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
  • Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Architect
  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect


Idiomas


  • Inglês – nível intermediário


Conhecimentos Técnicos Linguagens e Tecnologias


  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Backend: Python, Java, .Net ou Node.Js

Frameworks

  • Serverless Framework, Ruby on Rails, Express.Js, Laravel

Frontend

  • React, Vue.Js, Angular

Bancos de Dados

  • MySQL, SQL Server, DynamoDB, Redis

DevOps e Observabilidade

  • GitLab CI, GitHub Actions
  • ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana

APIs

  • RESTful, GraphQL
  • Swagger, Postman

Segurança

  • Fortify, Veracode, Acunetix, AppSpider, Checkmarx Interactive

Low-Code

  • OutSystems, Mendix ou Appian

UX/UI

  • Figma

Analytics

  • Google Analytics

Conhecimentos Técnicos Específicos


  • Sólido domínio de desenvolvimento Fullstack
  • Experiência no design e implementação de arquiteturas de microsserviços
  • Conhecimento avançado em DevSecOps , CI/CD e Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Implementação de autenticação e autorização em APIs (OAuth 2.0, JWT )
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs para catálogos de produtos, preços dinâmicos e gestão de pedidos
  • Experiência com técnicas de caching para alto volume de dados
  • Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais , especialmente MySQL
  • Experiência prática em AWS (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, SQS)
  • Uso de GitHub e boas práticas de versionamento


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com Serverless Framework
  • Interesse por arquitetura e boas práticas de engenharia de software
  • Conhecimento básico em observabilidade (logs, métricas e O11y)

title: Gerente Regional
description:
A Forno de Minas é uma empresa brasileira referência em alimentos, reconhecida nacional e internacionalmente pela qualidade, tradição e inovação. Com forte presença no varejo e expansão constante, levamos sabor e excelência para milhões de consumidores todos os dias.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Regional de Vendas – Retail & C&C para liderar a estratégia comercial e a execução do canal na região do Rio de Janeiro.

Essa posição é estratégica e terá papel fundamental na construção de crescimento sustentável, expansão de clientes e fortalecimento de parcerias com distribuidores e contas-chave.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar a equipe regional de vendas (direta e/ou indireta)
  • Definir e executar o plano regional alinhado às metas nacionais de volume, receita, margem e mix
  • Gerenciar o P&L regional com foco em crescimento lucrativo e controle de Opex
  • Negociar contratos, acordos comerciais e políticas de preço conforme diretrizes corporativas
  • Desenvolver relacionamento estratégico com grandes players de Retail e C&C
  • Monitorar KPIs (volume, margem, cobertura de mercado, execução comercial)
  • Atuar de forma transversal com Marketing, Supply Chain, Finanças e Customer Service
  • Analisar cenário competitivo e propor ações de crescimento


Perfil Desejado:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência sólida em vendas e gestão comercial no canal Retail/C&C
  • Histórico comprovado de liderança de equipes regionais
  • Forte visão de negócio e capacidade analítica
  • Excelente habilidade de negociação e relacionamento
  • Disponibilidade para viagens
  • Inglês será considerado diferencial


Buscamos um(a) profissional com:

  • Liderança inspiradora
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados
  • Pensamento estratégico com forte capacidade de execução
  • Tomada de decisão em ambientes dinâmicos
  • Comunicação clara e influência


Se você quer liderar uma região estratégica em uma marca forte e consolidada no mercado, essa oportunidade é para você.

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Nurse Offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.


Key Responsibilities

Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;

Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;

Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;

Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;

Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);

Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;

Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;

Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;

Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;

Provide First Aidtraining to designated first aid teams onboard;

Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);

Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.


Requirements

Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced life support and emergency care training;

Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;

Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Sales Director For An International Automotive And Energy Company In Rio De Jenerio
description:
Sales Director – Rio de Janeiro (RJ)


VORN


VORN is a global powerhouse headquartered in Beverly Hills, California, with offices across New York, London, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, Kolkata, Dhaka, Xiamen, Brisbane — and now expanding in Brazil .


Through our portfolio - Vorn.Com , we deliver premium B2B solutions across Automotive, Energy, Mobility, and Intelligence sectors , serving leading regional and international clients.


We are seeking an experienced Sales Director to lead and scale our Brazil operations , owning revenue growth, key accounts, and sales team performance across Brazil and selected international markets.


What You Will Do


  • Own and drive national and international B2B revenue for Brazil
  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing sales and business development team
  • Develop and execute sales strategies aligned with global leadership
  • Acquire, manage, and grow key enterprise and strategic accounts
  • Lead negotiations and close high-value, multi-year contracts
  • Establish partnerships with corporates, distributors, and procurement heads
  • Forecast revenue, manage pipelines, and report performance to global HQ
  • Work closely with global production, merchandising, marketing, and operations teams
  • Represent VORN at industry events, client meetings, and executive negotiations


Who We Are Looking For


Mandatory


  • Fluent Portuguese + strong English (business level)
  • 8–12+ years of experience in B2B sales, with 3–5+ years in a leadership role
  • Proven track record of building and scaling sales teams
  • Demonstrated success closing high-value enterprise and cross-border deals
  • Strong strategic thinking, negotiation, and executive-level presentation skills
  • Commercially sharp, data-driven, and results-oriented
  • Comfortable managing international clients and global stakeholders
  • Confident executive presence across in-person, video, and board-level meetings


Preferred (Strong Advantage)


  • Experience in automotive, energy, manufacturing, or industrial sectors
  • Existing C-level and procurement network in Brazil
  • Experience launching or scaling regional operations for global companies


What We Offer


  • Base Salary: R$18,000 – R$30,000 per month (experience-dependent)
  • Commission: Uncapped, performance-based
  • On-Target Earnings (OTE): R$35,000 – R$50,000+ per month
  • Top Performers: R$60,000+ per month
  • Annual performance and leadership bonus
  • Monday–Friday | Standard business hours
  • Executive laptop, mobile phone, CRM, and lead-generation tools
  • Marketing and inside-sales support with inbound leads
  • Direct influence on Brazil growth strategy
  • Clear path to Regional Director / LATAM leadership roles

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, CloudWatch), Angular (v19 or similar), RxJS / Observables, MyBatis and Liquibase.
  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Master Data Modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location

Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.G., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.


Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.


Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.


This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.


You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Representante Comercial (Rca) | Hunter Região Centro-Oeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Centro-Oeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp,, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Master Data Modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location

Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.G., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.


Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.


Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.


This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Ai Engineer
description:
AI Engineer (Document AI and LLM Applications)

Full time, Remote | Document Ingestion and RAG | Azure Preferred


Company Description

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled SaaS and automation products that help SMBs to enterprise teams move faster, operate leaner, and grow revenue without adding headcount. We create new software in categories that have been underserved or stuck in legacy tooling, especially in document-heavy, regulated environments where accuracy and auditability are non-negotiable. We build on modern Azure architecture and applied AI to deliver systems that are explainable, traceable, and production-ready.


We move fast, ship continuously, and measure impact in days and weeks, not quarters. If you want high ownership, hard problems, and the satisfaction of building products that do not exist yet, you’ll fit here.


Role Description

We are hiring an experienced AI Engineer with enterprise grade experience with large, complex PDF ingestion and document understanding. You will own the document AI core across our SaaS products and client deployments: ingestion, extraction, retrieval, grounded answers with citations, and evaluation. You will take messy, real-world documents that break most systems and turn them into reliable, measurable pipelines that power production workflows.


This is not a research role and not a prompt-only AI position. You will ship production-grade services, build the evaluation and quality infrastructure that keeps accuracy high over time, and set the standard for traceability, auditability, and cost-aware performance. You will be accountable for measurable quality: extraction accuracy, citation precision, latency, and cost.


Compensation

Compensation will be discussed and finalized based on experience, scope, and performance expectations. Equity or long-term incentive opportunities may be available for exceptional fits and can be discussed later in the process.


What You’ll Do

Core Engineering Responsibilities

  • Build real life multi agent AI systems and improve large-scale PDF ingestion pipelines across text, tables, images, and scans
  • Develop multi-agent architectures for cross-document analysis and comparison, specifically identifying delta-changes in clauses, endorsements, and schedules across large-scale PDF versions.
  • Design layout-aware extraction workflows for complex documents: multi-column, tables, forms, exhibits, endorsements
  • Create structured outputs from unstructured documents using schemas, validation, and confidence scoring
  • Partner with the team on architecture decisions, failure modes, and production hardening


Azure Cloud Engineering

  • Work within Azure-first architectures when implementing ingestion and retrieval systems
  • Use Azure services as needed (Blob Storage, Functions, Service Bus) to support scalable pipelines
  • Integrate relevant Azure AI services when appropriate (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Form Recognizer, Foundry, Microsoft Agent Framework (Orchestration SDK))


AI System Implementation

  • Familiarity with multi-agent systems, using LangChain, CrewAI, or Microsoft Foundry
  • Build GraphRAG and retrieval systems that produce grounded answers with citations and page-level traceability
  • Implement hybrid retrieval and reranking, chunking strategies, and document hierarchy modeling
  • Build evaluation harnesses: golden datasets, regression tests, hallucination and citation quality metrics
  • Optimize latency and cost: batching, caching, indexing strategies, and monitoring cost per document and per query


Collaboration and Code Quality

  • Ship clean, maintainable systems with strong documentation and tests
  • Work closely with engineering and product to translate requirements into reliable systems


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years in software engineering with 2+ years building production AI or document AI systems
  • Proven experience building PDF ingestion and document processing systems at scale
  • Strong understanding of OCR and layout-aware extraction and their failure modes
  • Production RAG experience with measurable evaluation, not just prototypes
  • Strong data and retrieval fundamentals: chunking, metadata, hybrid search, reranking
  • Comfortable with Python and modern backend development, and shipping production services


Strongly Preferred

  • Insurance policy analysis or legal document AI work
  • Understanding of policy structures: endorsements, exclusions, schedules, definitions, followed policies, year-over-year comparisons
  • Regulated environments where accuracy and auditability matter
  • Azure experience: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Form Recognizer, Blob Storage, Functions, Service Bus
  • Vector databases: pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or equivalents


Values and Working Style

  • A-player execution: you ship production systems, not prototypes
  • Obsessed with correctness, traceability, and repeatability
  • Strong ownership and accountability
  • Clear communication and practical problem solving under ambiguity
  • High standards for reliability, performance, and maintainability

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

-Based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.

  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS

  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently

  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments

Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset

  • Achievement drive and optimism

Why You Should Work at TurnKey
