title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Data Tech Lead
description:
Estamos procurando uma pessoa de tecnologia de dados experiente e inovador para liderar a estratégia de dados e a execução técnica. Esta função envolve liderar uma equipe de profissionais de dados, discutir arquiteturas de dados robustas e garantir a entrega de soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta qualidade que impulsionam a inteligência de negócios e a eficiência operacional.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Liderar e orientar uma equipe de engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e analistas de dados, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.
  • Discutir a arquitetura geral de dados, incluindo armazenamento de dados, data lakes, processos ETL/ELT e estruturas de governança de dados, considerando a escala ideal e o tempo de lançamento no mercado.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escalonáveis e confiáveis usando tecnologias apropriadas (por exemplo, Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka).
  • Colaborar com produtos, engenharia, e equipes de negócios para entender os requisitos de dados e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados em todas as plataformas e sistemas de dados.
  • Impulsionar a adoção das melhores práticas em engenharia de dados, modelagem de dados e operações de dados.
  • Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados.
  • Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados.
  • Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico de iniciativas de dados e roteiro de dados de longo prazo.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado;
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, arquitetura de dados ou função semelhante com foco em dados, com pelo menos 2 anos em capacidade de liderança técnica.


  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência liderando projetos de dados.


  • Forte proficiência em SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação comumente usada em engenharia de dados (por exemplo, Python, Scala, Java).


  • Ampla experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Azure e Databricks) e seus respectivos serviços de dados. (por exemplo, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka) é altamente desejável.


  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar, orientar e inspirar uma equipe técnica.


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, interpessoais e de resolução de problemas.


  • Forte pensamento analítico e uma abordagem baseada em dados para a tomada de decisões.

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Azure devops engineer
description: About you You are a senior-level Dev Ops Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You're comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions. You bring to Applaudo the following competencies: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experiencein senior or staff-level Dev Ops / Infrastructure Engineering roles. Professional certifications such as Azure Dev Ops, Terraform, or similar (preferred). Hands-on experience with Terraformand automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent). Strong proficiency with Azure services,including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure Open AI. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies(Docker, Kubernetes). Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta. Advanced skills in CI/CD automationusing Git Hub Actions, Azure Dev Ops, and related toolchains. Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, Power Shell, and/or Python. Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders. Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams. You will be accountable for the following responsibilities: Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security. Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, Postgre SQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability. Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions and Azure Dev Ops. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases. Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability. Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote Dev Ops culture, automation, and continuous improvement. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindsetat the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Java fullstack developer (angular)
description:
About YouYou are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
Hands-on experience with Postgre SQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, and Bedrock.
Experience using My Batis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of Rx JS and Observables.
Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using Rx JS and Observables.
Implement and manage data persistence using Postgre SQL, My Batis, Liquibase, and Redis.
Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.Qualifications
Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, Postgre SQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch), Angular (v19 or similar), Rx JS / Observables, My Batis and Liquibase.
Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.Additional Information
About UsAtApplaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with anAI-native mindsetat the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values:Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication.These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

title: Technical business analyst
description: About You You are atechnical, AI-enabled Business Analystwho thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners. You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined. You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms. Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure Dev Ops, Jira, or similar tools. Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows. Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage. Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners. Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams. Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency. Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Full professional proficiency in English. Familiarity with Azure cloud environments. Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers. Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do). You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners. Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests. Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support. Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps. Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment. Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities. Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives. Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies. Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations. Qualifications Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure Dev Ops / Jira), defect triage, and production support. Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindsetat the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Sales & trading intern
description:

Com sede em Greenwich, Connecticut, e escritórios em cidades estratégicas como Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Cidade do México e Singapura, a BCP é referência global em soluções financeiras personalizadas. Reconhecida por sua excelência e compromisso ético, a empresa oferece serviços inovadores e eficazes para atender às necessidades de clientes ao redor do mundo.
Sobre a BCP DTVM
A BCP DTVM é uma instituição financeira voltada para originação, estruturação e distribuição de ativos financeiros, com destaque para crédito privado e operações estruturadas. Nossa atuação inclui uma mesa ativa de negociações no mercado secundário, promovendo liquidez e transparência para os clientes.
Expandindo do mercado offshore para o mercado local, a BCP DTVM combina expertise técnica e agilidade, atendendo empresas, investidores institucionais e family offices com soluções sólidas e inovadoras. Somos o lugar certo para profissionais que buscam um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados, contribuindo para o futuro do mercado financeiro brasileiro.
Local de Trabalho: cidade do Rio de Janeiro, 100% presencial
Tipo de Contrato: estágio

Apoiar a mesa de Sales & Trading no acompanhamento diário do mercado local de renda fixa, com foco em crédito privado (debêntures, CRIs, CRAs, notas comerciais e outros instrumentos).
Auxiliar na atualização e controle das posições da mesa, acompanhando marcação a mercado, preços, spreads e movimentações diárias.

Monitorar e organizar o pipeline de oportunidades no mercado secundário, contribuindo com a execução e acompanhamento de negociações.
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e "market updates" (diários e semanais), incluindo destaques do mercado, principais movimentos e níveis indicativos.
Utilizar sistemas internos e plataformas de mercado (ex.: Bloomberg, ANBIMA, B3, CETIP/No Me/RTC, conforme aplicável) para consultas de preços, volumes e informações dos ativos.
Auxiliar na checagem de operações e interface com áreas de Middle/Backoffice, garantindo alinhamento entre negociação, registro e liquidação.
Organizar bases de dados, planilhas e controles internos, garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações.

Colaborar com o time na preparação de apresentações, materiais comerciais e documentos de apoio para reuniões com clientes.

title: Fotógrafo e filmmaker freelancer
description:
Descrição da EmpresaA Outlet de Ouro trabalha com peças em ouro 18k de segunda mão e joias de grandes grifes e alto padrão, em um processo que se inicia com compra de ouro, passa pela manutenção das joias em oficina e termina na exposição e venda das peças via Instagram e E-Commerce. (@outletdeouro).Descrição do CargoEstamos buscando um fotógrafo e filmmaker freelancer para algumas funções mistas, mas todas interligadas no processo da loja. A necessidade que identificamos é ter alguém conosco pelo menos 2 dias na semana, uma vez que temos como demandas principais o seguinte: 1. Tirar fotos e vídeos de mais de 50 novas joias por semana, incluindo diferentes ângulos para a mesma joia; 2. A fotografia e gravação de videos profissionais em estúdio com nossas modelos usando algumas das peças e 3. A criação de conteúdo criativo mobile, como stories de Instagram e Trends de Tiktok, de forma que a criatividade e proatividade são também fundamentais. OBS: 1 desses 2 dias de trabalho da semana é exclusivamente separado para as fotos das joias como no estilo atual do nosso feed, que o candidato pode buscar no Instagram para entender. Isso ocorre pois o fluxo de peças é muito grande e para além de Instagram também trabalhamos com grupo de Whats App. O cargo possui horário e dias flexíveis, que serão combinados semanalmente, mas as atividades são em sua maioria presenciais no Rio de Janeiro, principalmente nos nossos escritórios do Recreio dos Bandeirantes e Barra da Tijuca.
Qualificações
Fotografia e Edição:Experiência em técnicas fotográficas, composição e edição de imagens utilizando programas como Adobe Photoshop e Lightroom. De preferência experiência semelhante com vídeos.
Organização e Planejamento:Habilidade em planejar cronogramas de sessões fotográficas e gerenciar o tempo de maneira eficaz.
Experiência prévia em fotografia de produtos e editorial com modelos é essencial.

title: Sales manager
description:
Job Responsibilities
Support the implementation of the company’s strategic initiatives for brand, products, sales and services in Brazil.
Be responsible for local market development and formulate industry development insight plans (target customer industries mainly include petrochemicals/oil & gas/chemical engineering/energy & power/metallurgy/building materials/paper & pulping/food & pharmaceuticals/coal mining, etc.).

Bachelor’s degree or above, major in automation, minor languages and other related majors is preferred.

Proficiency in Portuguese communication and a good understanding of Latin American culture.
Be willing to accept medium and long-term overseas assignment.
Working experience in the automation/intelligentization/digitalization industry is a plus.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.Experience
Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit
